thread: Back from the break, what is on fire?
subject: Back from the break, what is on fire?
body:
Karin,

Back at my desk. Skimmed the inbox and I see three things that need a person: the AV quote for the winter demo day, the mentor availability sheet that still has holes, and a landlord notice about the lift at Slussen being out on the 8th. I'll start with the mentor sheet unless you say otherwise.

Daniel

thread: Back from the break, what is on fire?
subject: Re: Back from the break, what is on fire?
body:
Mentor sheet first, yes. The lift can wait, we are on the second floor and nobody has a wheelchair booked that day. AV quote I will read tonight and send you my view.

Round 1 closes on Monday night, so expect the inbox to get louder from Saturday.

K

thread: Quote: sound and screens for the winter demo day
subject: Quote: sound and screens for the winter demo day
body:
Hi Daniel,

As discussed on the phone before Christmas, here is our offer for the winter demo day at your office.

Two wireless handhelds, one lectern microphone, two powered speakers, a 65 inch screen on a stand, and one technician from 15:00 until the doors close. Delivery and pick-up inside Stockholm are included. Total 14 800 SEK excluding VAT.

If you want the livestream camera as well we can add it for 3 200 SEK. Say yes before the 16th and I can hold the same technician.

Gustav
Ljudhuset AV

thread: Demo day catering, first thoughts
subject: Demo day catering, first thoughts
body:
Hej Daniel,

Happy new year. For the winter demo day I would suggest a standing menu rather than plates: three warm bites, two vegetarian, one with fish, plus a cheese board and the sparkling elderflower you liked in December. Coffee station runs until the last guest leaves.

Tell me roughly how many guests you expect and whether we need to cover nut allergies on the whole menu or just label them. I will send a price once I have a number.

Elin, Slussen Kök

thread: Newsletter: January draft is in the shared folder
subject: Newsletter: January draft is in the shared folder
body:
Karin, the January newsletter draft is in the shared folder. Order is: a short note from you, the customer interview lab on the 29th, two blog links, then the thank-you to the mentors who covered the holiday office hours.

I kept it under 400 words. The subject line is still open: "Notes from Slussen, January" or something with the lab in it. Which do you prefer?

Sofia

thread: Newsletter: January draft is in the shared folder
subject: Re: Newsletter: January draft is in the shared folder
body: Go with "Notes from Slussen, January". Cut the sentence about the weather, it dates the mail badly. Otherwise good, send it Tuesday morning.

thread: Mentor availability: who has not answered
subject: Mentor availability: who has not answered
body:
Daniel, status of the availability sheet as of this morning. Astrid, Ingrid, Henrik and Joonas have filled in January. Fredrik is travelling until the 12th and says he will do it from the airport. Liis, Mari and Oskar have not replied at all.

I will chase the three by phone today. If I get a yes from all of them the sheet is complete by Wednesday and you can run the first session assignments.

Nora

thread: Your January availability, please
to: Liis Kask <liis.kask@mentors.fieldnote.example>, Mari Tamm <mari.tamm@mentors.fieldnote.example>, Oskar Bergman <oskar.bergman@mentors.fieldnote.example>
subject: Your January availability, please
body:
Hi all,

Short and friendly reminder: the availability sheet is still missing your January weekdays. Two minutes is all it takes. Tick the weekdays you can host, and your monthly capacity if it changed since autumn.

If something in the sheet is confusing, answer this mail and I will fill it in for you from what you say.

Nora

thread: Your January availability, please
subject: Re: Your January availability, please
body:
Sorry, Nora, I was on a farm with no signal. Tuesdays and Thursdays work, capacity the same as before. Can we skip the last week of January? My daughter has a school trip and I am the driver.

Mari

thread: Your January availability, please
subject: Re: Your January availability, please
body:
Thursdays only this month, and at most two sessions. The new job eats my evenings. I can do more in February.

Oskar

thread: Invoice 2025-1187, Fieldnote, December bookkeeping
subject: Invoice 2025-1187, Fieldnote, December bookkeeping
body:
Hej Anders,

Attached is our invoice for December bookkeeping, 4 250 SEK plus VAT, due in 30 days. I also corrected the supplier ledger: last month's fee was entered twice on our side, so there is a credit of 1 900 SEK that I have netted against this invoice. That is the only adjustment on it, everything else is as in the engagement letter.

Ulrika
Ekonomibyrån

thread: Invoice 2025-1187, Fieldnote, December bookkeeping
subject: Re: Invoice 2025-1187, Fieldnote, December bookkeeping
body: Thanks Ulrika. Credit noted, I will pay it in Friday's run. Could you send the ledger extract as a PDF as well, the auditors asked for it in the spring and I would rather have it ready.

thread: Hamnkontoret: the large hall for 26 February?
subject: Hamnkontoret: the large hall for 26 February?
body:
Hello Daniel,

You asked about the large hall for the evening of 26 February. It is free from 14:00. The hall seats 120 theatre style or 80 at tables. Setup crews can arrive at 12:00 for no extra charge. The rental is 9 500 SEK for the evening, cleaning included.

We keep a tentative booking for ten days. After that it goes back on the market.

Lars Thulin

thread: Venue decision: office or Hamnkontoret for demo day
subject: Venue decision: office or Hamnkontoret for demo day
body:
Karin,

Two options for the winter demo day. Our own office: free, but 60 guests at the very most and the coat rack problem we had in December. Hamnkontoret: 9 500 SEK, hall for 120, a proper stage and a cloakroom.

Last time we turned away 22 people at the door. I lean towards Hamnkontoret. The money is there in the events line if Anders agrees.

Daniel

thread: Venue decision: office or Hamnkontoret for demo day
subject: Re: Venue decision: office or Hamnkontoret for demo day
body: Book Hamnkontoret. Ask Anders to confirm the line and tell Lars we confirm before the ten days are up. And please ask them for a quiet room backstage for the pitching teams.

thread: Alumni dinner, save the date
subject: Alumni dinner, save the date
body:
Hello everyone,

We are planning the winter alumni dinner for Thursday 12 February, 18:30 at the office. Last year's dinner turned into a three-hour conversation about hiring, so this time we will seat people by topic. Tell us in the sign-up form which table you want to be at.

Partners are welcome. We will confirm numbers a week ahead.

Tomas
Community manager

thread: Alumni dinner, save the date
subject: Re: Alumni dinner, save the date
body: Count me and my co-founder in. Could the table by topic include one about selling to the public sector? We are drowning in procurement paperwork and would love to compare notes.

thread: Call page: when do you want the round 2 text?
subject: Call page: when do you want the round 2 text?
body:
Karin, the round 2 page is built and waiting on a green light. I need your final text for the contact box, and the publish time. Last time we went live at 09:00 on a Thursday and got more sign-ups than on any other launch day, so I suggest the same: Thursday the 15th at 09:00.

Sofia

thread: Call page: when do you want the round 2 text?
subject: Re: Call page: when do you want the round 2 text?
body: 15th at 09:00 is fine. Contact box says programme@fieldnote.example, nothing personal. I will read the page tomorrow morning on paper one last time.

thread: Your Postwise plan renews on 20 January
subject: Your Postwise plan renews on 20 January
body:
Hi Sofia,

This is a heads-up that your Standard plan renews on 20 January. The price is going up by 8 percent after our annual price review, which is an adjustment we apply to all customers on the older plan. If you want to switch to the Starter plan or cancel, you can do it in Settings before the renewal date.

The Postwise team

thread: Your Postwise plan renews on 20 January
subject: Fwd: Your Postwise plan renews on 20 January
body: Anders, do we keep Postwise? We send two newsletters a month to about 1 800 people and the cheaper Starter plan covers 2 000 contacts, but it has no automation and no A/B subject lines. I never used the automation. Your call.

thread: Fwd: Your Postwise plan renews on 20 January
subject: Re: Fwd: Your Postwise plan renews on 20 January
body: Move to Starter. If we need an A/B test I will ask for a one-month upgrade. Please also delete the 300 or so bounced addresses so we do not hit the limit on the first day.

thread: Tallinn trip, 4 to 6 February: flights and hotel
subject: Tallinn trip, 4 to 6 February: flights and hotel
body:
Hej Daniel,

Options for you and Karin to Tallinn. Morning flight on the 4th at 07:25, arriving 09:50 local time, or the 18:10 evening flight if you would rather work in the office first. Return on the 6th at 17:40 in both cases.

Hotel: the Telegraaf is full on the 5th. Two rooms at Hotel Viru are 1 350 SEK a night each including breakfast, five minutes from Tallinn Tech Hub. Fare is refundable until 48 hours before departure.

Mia
Harbourline Travel

thread: Tallinn trip, 4 to 6 February: flights and hotel
subject: Re: Tallinn trip, 4 to 6 February: flights and hotel
body: Morning flight please, and the Viru for both of us. One thing: Karin wants a vegetarian meal on board, I do not mind. Can you also put an aisle seat on hers?

thread: Meeting in Tallinn on the 5th
subject: Meeting in Tallinn on the 5th
body:
Hi Katrin,

Daniel and I will be in Tallinn from the 4th to the 6th and we would like to see the Tech Hub and meet the people who run your founder evenings. Does the 5th around 10:00 work? We have a few ideas about co-hosting a demo evening in the autumn and want to hear what has worked for you.

Best,
Karin

thread: Meeting in Tallinn on the 5th
subject: Re: Meeting in Tallinn on the 5th
body:
Karin, lovely. Come at 10:00 and stay for lunch, the canteen on the ground floor is surprisingly good. I will invite Tiina who handles the events and our community lead. Bring a laptop if you want to show your website, they are curious about how the application page works.

Katrin

thread: Run finished, please look at the inbox
subject: Run finished, please look at the inbox
body:
Karin, the ranking job for round 1 finished at 06:04 and wrote its output to the shared drive. Nothing else to report from my side. The invitations list is in the usual place.

The part-time engineer

thread: Round 1 invitations: next steps
subject: Round 1 invitations: next steps
body: Daniel, the list is done, please start the invitation mails in the afternoon through the usual queue. I want the first batch out before lunch tomorrow at the latest. Remember to include the room and the two sessions for questions.

thread: Round 1 invitations: next steps
subject: Re: Round 1 invitations: next steps
body: On it. I will not hand-write anything, everything goes through the mail queue like last time. Will tell you when the batches have been sent.

thread: Print proof: January newsletter flyer
subject: Print proof: January newsletter flyer
body:
Hi Sofia,

Proof attached for the A5 flyer that goes in the office lobby. The orange is slightly darker than on screen because of the paper stock. If you want it closer we can switch to a coated paper for 1.10 SEK more per sheet.

The file arrived with the right bleed this time, thanks. Print run of 300 is ready in two days after you approve.

Petra, Nordlys Print

thread: Print proof: January newsletter flyer
subject: Re: Print proof: January newsletter flyer
body: Approved with the darker orange. Skip the coated paper, nobody reads those flyers for longer than the coffee takes to cool.

thread: Slot adjustment for my February sessions
subject: Slot adjustment for my February sessions
body:
Nora, I have to move two of my February sessions because the board meeting I chair has been rescheduled to the third Wednesday. Could you shift whoever was booked on Wednesday the 18th to the Tuesday before, same time? If they cannot make Tuesday I am happy to do a Friday lunch instead.

Ingrid

thread: Slot adjustment for my February sessions
subject: Re: Slot adjustment for my February sessions
body: Done. I wrote to both startups and asked them to confirm by Friday. I will keep the Wednesday free in the sheet in case one of them says no.

thread: Quarterly report: dates for the next funder meeting
subject: Quarterly report: dates for the next funder meeting
body:
Dear Karin,

The funder group meets on 19 February at 10:00. We would like twenty minutes on the intake numbers and ten on the demo day plans. Please send the two-page summary a week before, so a copy reaches everyone who attends.

Berit Lund
Stockholm Regional Fund

thread: Funder summary: need numbers from you
subject: Funder summary: need numbers from you
body: Anders, I need the cohort cost per startup and the budget status for the funder summary by 11 February. A simple table is enough. Any variance over 10 percent needs a line of explanation.

thread: Round 2: the call opens tomorrow
subject: Round 2: the call opens tomorrow
body:
Hello,

A short note to say that our round 2 call opens tomorrow, Thursday 15 January, at 09:00 Stockholm time. Everything you need will be on the call page at that moment, along with the rubric.

We are also holding an open Q&A call on 20 January at 12:00 for anyone who wants to ask us anything. A link will be in the page.

The Fieldnote programme team

thread: Staging check done
subject: Staging check done
body: Karin, everything on the staging site reads fine, links work, the contact box is as agreed. One question: the hero photo of the office is from the autumn and shows Daniel's coat on a chair. Do we care?

thread: Staging check done
subject: Re: Staging check done
body: Ha. Swap the photo for the one with the lunch table, and tell Daniel his coat was famous for a day.

thread: Security office hours: remote or in person?
subject: Security office hours: remote or in person?
body:
Nora,

Several startups asked if my engineering and security office hours could be on video so they do not have to cross town. I prefer in person for the first session and video after. Is that all right with the programme?

Henrik

thread: Security office hours: remote or in person?
subject: Re: Security office hours: remote or in person?
body: Perfectly fine. I will update the mentor guide with a sentence on it and add a video link to your calendar entries.

thread: Portrait session: invoice and file delivery
subject: Portrait session: invoice and file delivery
body:
Hi Tomas,

The portraits from the winter cohort session are ready: 44 edited images in the gallery, password in the next mail. My invoice, 6 600 SEK plus VAT, is attached. If you want the black and white set for the mentor pages, tell me by Friday, otherwise I will archive the raw files after thirty days.

Hanna Ek

thread: Call is live
subject: Call is live
body: Karin, the round 2 page is live as of 09:00:00, feed has the item, and I have clicked through on a phone and two laptops. Social posts are scheduled at 09:30. I will keep an eye on the contact mailbox until noon.

thread: Call is live
subject: Re: Call is live
body: Three people have already written to the contact mailbox, all asking where to find the recording of the Q&A call (there is no recording yet, the call is on the 20th). I answered all three with the same two lines. Might be worth a sentence on the page.

thread: Call is live
subject: Re: Call is live
body: Add the sentence about the call date to the page, yes. Sofia can do it in her next slot.

thread: Travel budget, Tallinn
subject: Travel budget, Tallinn
body: Karin, the Tallinn trip comes to roughly 11 900 SEK all in. That is within the line, but we have used 70 percent of the travel budget for the half-year already, so please no more unplanned trips until summer.

thread: Quote: sound and screens for the winter demo day
subject: Re: Quote: sound and screens for the winter demo day
body: Hi Daniel, a gentle nudge. The technician hold expires today. If you want the livestream camera as well, tell me before 17:00 and I will lock both.

thread: Quote: sound and screens for the winter demo day
subject: Re: Quote: sound and screens for the winter demo day
body: Yes to both, camera included. Please send a revised quote with a total. The venue changed: we are moving from our office to Hamnkontoret, so delivery goes to the harbour address.

thread: Quote: sound and screens for the winter demo day
subject: Re: Quote: sound and screens for the winter demo day
body: Understood. New total 18 000 SEK excluding VAT. The adjustment from the first quote is the camera and a longer cable run, which the hall needs. Revised document attached.

thread: Hamnkontoret: booking confirmation
subject: Hamnkontoret: booking confirmation
body:
Hello Daniel,

We confirm the large hall for 26 February from 12:00 for setup until 22:00. Invoice follows after the event. Please let us know the number of guests two days before, and whether you need the cloakroom staffed.

Lars Thulin

thread: Alumni newsletter: first draft of the spring issue
subject: Alumni newsletter: first draft of the spring issue
body:
Karin, I have a first draft of the alumni newsletter. Features: three founders on what changed after demo day, a hiring checklist from Ingrid, the alumni dinner on the 12th, and a short note about the mentor office hours. I would love your comment on the tone, it reads more formal than I wanted.

Tomas

thread: Alumni newsletter: first draft of the spring issue
subject: Re: Alumni newsletter: first draft of the spring issue
body: Tone is fine but long. Cut the hiring checklist to six bullets and give the three founders their own pictures. Do not promise anything new about the programme in it, this is a letter about them.

thread: Office wifi password rotated
subject: Office wifi password rotated
body: Hi all, the guest wifi password changes this afternoon. New one is on the whiteboard in the kitchen. Staff network stays as it was. If your laptop falls off the network at some point today, that is why.

thread: Your talk proposal: Nordic Startup Days
subject: Your talk proposal: Nordic Startup Days
body:
Dear Karin,

Thank you for your proposal "What an accelerator learns from 600 applications". The programme committee reviews proposals in two rounds. Please note that your document was received after the deadline for the first round, so it will be reviewed in the second round on 6 February. This does not reduce your chances, but the room allocation will be decided later.

Best regards,
Nordic Startup Days programme committee

thread: Your talk proposal: Nordic Startup Days
subject: Fwd: Your talk proposal: Nordic Startup Days
body: Sofia, can you tidy the abstract for me and check the title? The committee only gave us a second chance because of the late submission, and I want to make it count. I wrote it on the train.

thread: Round 2: open Q&A call today at 12:00
subject: Round 2: open Q&A call today at 12:00
body:
Hello,

Our open Q&A call starts at 12:00 today. It runs for about 45 minutes and the link is on the call page. Bring your questions on the programme, the mentors and what a week in the programme looks like. We will not be going through individual applications on the call.

The Fieldnote programme team

thread: Q&A call, three themes
subject: Q&A call, three themes
body: Karin, summary of the Q&A for your notes. People mostly asked about: how mentors are chosen, whether remote companies can join, and what the demo day is like. Nobody asked anything hard. About 31 people joined and the chat was friendly.

thread: Judge briefing for demo day: am I in?
subject: Judge briefing for demo day: am I in?
body:
Daniel,

You asked if I could be on the demo day panel. Yes, but only if I may bring a short rubric of my own for the pitch itself, separate from the programme's. I have found that panels agree more when they score pitching and substance on different sheets.

Astrid

thread: Judge briefing for demo day: am I in?
subject: Re: Judge briefing for demo day: am I in?
body: Brilliant. Send me your sheet and I will check with Karin whether the panel can use two forms. I am sure it is fine for demo day, it is a separate thing from our application review.

thread: Demo day panel: scheduling and conflicts
subject: Demo day panel: scheduling and conflicts
body:
Karin,

I can join the panel on 26 February provided we start by 17:00, I have a board dinner after. I should also say that one of the teams in the cohort is a company my fund has looked at before, so I will want to recuse myself from scoring that team. Is there a standard way to do it?

Pontus

thread: Demo day panel: scheduling and conflicts
subject: Re: Demo day panel: scheduling and conflicts
body: Thank you. We start at 17:00 sharp. For conflicts: tell Daniel which team and he will hand you a form without that name. You still sit on the panel, you just do not score that team.

thread: Call page: wording in the footer
subject: Call page: wording in the footer
body: Karin, tiny thing. The footer on the call page says "Questions? Mail us" and the rest of the site says "Questions? Write to us". I prefer "Write to us". It is one word. May I change it?

thread: Call page: wording in the footer
subject: Re: Call page: wording in the footer
body: Yes, change it. Consistency matters more than which word.

thread: Quarter close: three questions
subject: Quarter close: three questions
body:
Hej Anders,

For the quarter close I need three things. The bank statement for the travel card, the sponsor's invoice that was credited in November, and your decision whether the demo day deposit should be booked in January or February. My advice is February, when the service is delivered.

Ulrika

thread: Quarter close: three questions
subject: Re: Quarter close: three questions
body: Statement attached. Credited invoice is in the folder named "Nov". Deposit goes in February as you say.

thread: Cancelling Friday
subject: Cancelling Friday
body: Nora, I have to cancel the Friday session. Food poisoning, probably the sushi. Please tell the startup I am sorry and offer them next Monday in the afternoon.

thread: Cancelling Friday
subject: Re: Cancelling Friday
body: Get well. I will rebook Monday 14:00 and send an apology with a coffee voucher.

thread: Catering: guest numbers and a price
subject: Catering: guest numbers and a price
body:
Hej Daniel,

With 110 guests expected my price is 285 SEK per person for the standing menu, 31 350 SEK in total, excluding VAT. A cheaper variant without fish brings it to 260 per person. Drinks are separate, as before.

I need the final number a week before. A late headcount adjustment of up to ten people is no problem, more than that needs two days' notice for the kitchen.

Elin

thread: Catering and AV total for demo day
subject: Catering and AV total for demo day
body: Karin, the numbers for demo day so far. Venue 9 500, AV 18 000, catering 31 350, all excluding VAT, plus photographer 3 800 and print about 2 100. About 65 000 SEK in total, which is 6 000 above what we pencilled. I will ask Elin for the fish-free price to see what we can save.

thread: Catering and AV total for demo day
subject: Re: Catering and AV total for demo day
body: Take the fish-free menu if it saves 25 SEK per head. The sponsors have always been happy as long as the coffee is hot.

thread: Call page: button colour
subject: Call page: button colour
body: Hi, the "Apply" button on the call page is a dark teal that looks grey on some monitors. I tried a slightly brighter teal. Look at the staging link and tell me if you prefer it. The only thing that changes is the colour, nothing else on the page.

thread: Call page: button colour
subject: Re: Call page: button colour
body: Brighter looks better to me, and it passes the contrast checker on my laptop.

thread: Insurance renewal
subject: Insurance renewal
body: Karin, the office insurance renews on 1 March. The broker proposes a slightly higher excess and a lower premium. I would take the lower premium. Can you sign the form on Thursday?

thread: Helsinki day trip: train or flight?
subject: Helsinki day trip: train or flight?
body:
Hej Daniel,

For the Helsinki visit I can book a morning flight at 07:05 with the return at 19:40, or the overnight ferry out and a flight back. The ferry is cheaper by 700 SEK each, but you lose the evening before. Tell me which and I will hold seats until Wednesday.

Mia

thread: Helsinki day trip: train or flight?
subject: Re: Helsinki day trip: train or flight?
body: Flight, both ways. I do not want to be on a ferry the night before a presentation.

thread: Helsinki Founders House: co-working day
subject: Helsinki Founders House: co-working day
body:
Karin,

We would be glad to host a visit from your team on 13 March. Our community of about two hundred founders would like a talk and a few mentor sessions. We can provide a room for 40 and a projector, and our own lunch. We cannot pay a speaker fee, but we do cover travel.

Juho Kallio

thread: Helsinki Founders House: co-working day
subject: Re: Helsinki Founders House: co-working day
body: Juho, 13 March works for us. Daniel will coordinate times and who is coming. I would like to bring two mentors, one for fundraising and one for product.

thread: Black and white set approved?
subject: Black and white set approved?
body: Tomas, a reminder only. The black and white versions of the mentor portraits would take me about two hours. Tell me if I should go ahead and I will invoice 1 400 SEK for the work.

thread: Black and white set approved?
subject: Re: Black and white set approved?
body: Yes please, do the set. The mentor pages will be better for it.

thread: Customer interview lab tomorrow: room layout
subject: Customer interview lab tomorrow: room layout
body: Hi all, the customer interview lab is tomorrow evening. The room is set as a horseshoe with six small tables at the back for role plays. Joonas facilitates and Mari helps. Doors at 17:30. I could use two volunteers to greet people.

thread: Round 2: schedule for the weeks ahead
subject: Round 2: schedule for the weeks ahead
body:
Hello,

We want you to have a rough picture of what happens when. There is an open Q&A call (done), the closing of the application window, a short quiet period while we review, and then interviews for the companies we invite. We will write to you directly with dates for each step well before it happens.

Until then the call page is the one place to check for anything about the call itself.

The Fieldnote programme team

thread: Call page: photo swap
subject: Call page: photo swap
body: Karin, the lunch table photo you picked is nicer but the file was 4 MB and slowed the page on mobile. I compressed it to 380 KB, no visible difference. Just so you know why the filename changed.

thread: Call page: photo swap
subject: Re: Call page: photo swap
body: Thanks for telling me. Always compress, I do not need to be asked.

thread: Lab tonight: attendance
subject: Lab tonight: attendance
body: Nora, 38 people registered, 31 have confirmed this morning. We will have enough chairs. Coffee is ordered. The kitchen is leaving a tray of cinnamon buns.

thread: Invoice 4471 and a late file
subject: Invoice 4471 and a late file
body:
Hi Sofia,

Invoice 4471 for the flyers is attached, 2 640 SEK including VAT. We also had your second file for the poster on Wednesday afternoon. That one was received after the deadline for Thursday's print run, so the posters will be ready on Monday instead. Nothing extra to pay for the later run.

Petra

thread: Invoice 4471 and a late file
subject: Fwd: Invoice 4471 and a late file
body: Anders, invoice for the flyers. Please pay it from the marketing line. The posters were my fault, I sent the file late.

thread: January close: preliminary
subject: January close: preliminary
body: Karin, January is nearly closed. Spending is slightly above plan, mainly because of the venue deposit, which will balance out in February. The funder summary draft will be with you on Friday.

thread: Quarterly report: dates for the next funder meeting
subject: Re: Quarterly report: dates for the next funder meeting
body: Karin, one more request from the funder group: a short paragraph on how we handle applications from companies outside Sweden. They know about the Nordic and Baltic profile and want one clean paragraph for the minutes. A plain description is fine.

thread: Quarterly report: dates for the next funder meeting
subject: Re: Quarterly report: dates for the next funder meeting
body: Berit, I will include a paragraph in the summary that arrives on 12 February. It will describe who can apply and how we welcome founders from across the region, in general terms.

thread: February availability and a request
subject: February availability and a request
body:
Nora,

Back from my travels. My February availability is up in the sheet. One request: could I do evening sessions on two Tuesdays instead of lunchtimes? Founders who have day jobs have been asking.

Fredrik

thread: February availability and a request
subject: Re: February availability and a request
body: Evening Tuesdays are fine. I will mark the 10th and the 24th and make sure the coordinator knows the office is open late. Thanks for being flexible.
